risks.title: Dependence on general economic conditions
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned in the first part of the 10-K, with strong language on potential negative impact on revenues. It is repeated across multiple sections, indicating a central concern. The Macro category is highly weighted in severity. The risk is stable compared to the prior year.

risks.title: Increased competition in advertising media
risks.score_rationale: The document highlights industry fragmentation and competition with digital media, particularly mobile, social, and online. The language indicates a direct threat to market share. The category is critical to the business model. Central placement in the 10-K, trend stable.

risks.title: Risks related to digital transition
risks.score_rationale: The text mentions high costs and delays in digital screen deployment, with impacts on results. The language reflects critical dependence on technology. The Technology category is strategic. Persistent risk, therefore stable.

risks.title: Dependence on public contracts for the Transit segment
risks.score_rationale: Contract renewals with municipalities are described as competitive and uncertain. The Transit segment is strategic. The language emphasizes the critical nature of renewals. Explicitly mentioned in the 10-K, trend stable.

risks.title: Organizational restructuring and associated costs
risks.score_rationale: The 6% workforce reduction plan is recent (2025), with $20.1 million in charges. The language indicates a major strategic adjustment. Although the amount is significant, it is one-time. New risk, therefore classified as 'new'.

risks.title: Dependence on third parties for technology and installation
risks.score_rationale: The text explicitly mentions delays and price increases due to external suppliers for digital screens and advertising platforms. Strong language on negative impact. Recurring risk, therefore stable. Technology category highly critical.

risks.title: Seasonal fluctuations in advertising revenues
risks.score_rationale: The document clearly notes that revenues are lower in the first quarter. Although predictable, it affects revenue consistency. Language is descriptive, not alarming. Mentioned in KPIs, therefore integrated. Trend stable.

ai_positioning.summary: The company does not mention artificial intelligence in its report.
